name: callables survive a container and a sum, and the reverse direction carries them too
note: Sinks is a map of records of callables and Outcome is a union one of whose arms carries them, so this drives the positions a live value is permitted in beyond a plain field. It also runs the other way: the server calls supervise on the client, handing it callables the client then calls.

steps.note: a map of callables in the request, a union in the result
the client called each callable the server handed it, in key order
